news.headline: Raymond James Adjusts Price Target on ConocoPhillips to $170 From $168

ExxonMobil Increases Stakes in Rovuma LNG and Papua LNG Projects
news.summary: ExxonMobil has reached agreements to increase its ownership in the Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique to 50% and the Papua LNG project in Papua New Guinea to 34%.
